verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs list a built-in Schedule trigger for workflows, and a community comment cites a separate execution limit for cron, so scheduled runs are a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence documents cron expression syntax or any timezone setting for schedules. missing for 10: documented cron-expression syntax, timezone selection/control for schedules, in-depth scheduling docs, hands-on corroboration of timezone behavior

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run workflows on cron-style schedules with timezone control

citations.quote: Today, we support the following triggers: ... HTTP / Webhook ... Schedule ... Email ... RSS
Triggers for apps like Twitter, GitHub, and more, HTTP / Webhook, Schedule, Email, RSS
